description: A shell script that sets up a series of git log graph visualization tests for complex merge scenarios including octopus merges with various crossover and unrelated commits. It contains test cases verifying log graph output with and without color formatting, as well as different merge complexities.

methods.name: test_cmp_graph
methods.description: Compares the current git log graph output with the expected output, disabling color.

methods.name: test_cmp_colored_graph
methods.description: Compares the current git log graph output with colored output with the expected color-coding.
